pairs.subject: serving-process-topology
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/AssetScoutView/index.tsx:1 These are browser-side React views: AssetScoutView and PostProcessStudioView read Zustand stores and pass CLI work to useModuleCLI. A case-insensitive grep of both directories for spawn, child_process, fork, worker, replica, cluster, process., load balancing, startMethod, inference, serving and subprocess found nothing, so the subject's precondition (a latency-critical serving loop decomposed into processes) does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/PostProcessStudioView/index.tsx:7 The studio has no inner loop with a latency budget. Long work goes to the shared CLI hook, so there is no iteration in this context to isolate.
src/components/modules/evaluator/AssetScoutView/index.tsx:10 State lives in one in-browser client store. There are no replicas and no balancer for cache residency to constrain.
src/components/modules/evaluator/PostProcessStudioView/index.tsx:6 Each view reads its own Zustand store. No engine/executor/worker hierarchy threads configuration through constructors.

src/components/modules/evaluator/AssetScoutView/index.tsx:14 No process is created in this context, so no process-creation strategy is chosen here. Spawning happens outside it, behind the CLI hook and service.
